$comment: Shape consumed by scripts/build_folio_pdf.py. Extra keys are ignored.
title: string (required)
subtitle: string
author: string (required)
genre: report | monograph | working-paper | paper | living-document | think-tank
canonical_url: string (optional override; builder writes {origin}/white-papers/{slug} when empty)
filename: string (optional; builder computes YYYY-topic-slug-wca-folio.pdf when empty)

owner.legal: Web Development Corporation, a Delaware Corporation

sections.title: I. Introduction
paragraphs: string with optional {{1}} or {{1, 4, 9}} markers, or equation object with type, plate, caption, itqe

notes.text: Chicago note-form markup (i, em, b, a href).

bibliography: Chicago bibliographic-form markup, first-appearance order (string or {work_id, text}).
